brief: Prioritise Camden Green for pre-event attention because of its oil issue, as oil condition defects awaiting reconditioning are category 4 items in SOP-016. Because this is an ageing unit of 52 years with an oil issue and an ONAN cooling type, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure if it cannot be attended before the event in accordance with MG-023. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period as required by MG-021.
